source.description: Project parser point where attacker-controlled PKCS#15 ASN.1 bytes are decoded by OpenSC.
source.note: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput passes Data/Size to sc_pkcs15_decode_prkdf_entry; the scored source is the OpenSC ASN.1 decoder consuming *buf, not the fuzzing entry function.

taint_source.description: Attacker-controlled ASN.1 input enters the PKCS#15 private-key decoder.
taint_source.note: The decode result and ASN.1 entry flags are determined by the attacker-controlled buffer.

tainted_value_origin.description: First vulnerability-relevant parsed state: decoder return status and ASN.1 presence flags derived from attacker bytes.
tainted_value_origin.note: The bad-free path requires r < 0 while the common private-key subject entry is marked present.

sink.description: ASan crash location: free is called on asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm, which points into stack variable info rather than to malloc-owned memory.

root_cause.description: Root cause: the error cleanup frees the ASN.1 descriptor parameter pointer instead of freeing the decoded heap value stored in info.subject.value. asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm was initialized to &info.subject.value at line 252, so it is stack storage metadata, not owned heap data.

coarse_trace.summary: Sets up ASN.1 descriptor entries for a PKCS#15 private-key object and binds the subject entry to info.subject.value.
Decodes attacker-controlled ASN.1 bytes into the descriptor graph and local info fields.
On decoder error, checks presence flags and enters cleanup for possibly allocated subject data.
Frees the descriptor parm pointer itself, which points into the stack frame, instead of freeing info.subject.value.

root_cause_analysis.summary: sc_pkcs15_decode_prkdf_entry prepares ASN.1 descriptors so the common private-key subject entry writes through &info.subject.value. The attacker-controlled ASN.1 input makes sc_asn1_decode_choice fail after marking the common private-key attribute present. The error cleanup tries to release possible decoded subject storage, but it frees asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm. That field is the descriptor parameter pointer initialized to &info.subject.value, so free receives a stack address inside local variable info. The real heap value to release is info.subject.value.
root_cause_analysis.why_patch_works: The patch replaces free(asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm) with free(info.subject.value). This targets the actual decoded value pointer rather than the descriptor slot address, so cleanup no longer passes a stack address to free while still releasing the allocation that may have been produced before the ASN.1 error.

stack_object_context.detail: Bad-free address is inside stack variable info; asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm points to &info.subject.value.
